name: Aasimar
traits: Celestial Resistance — resistance to Necrotic and Radiant damage
Darkvision 60 ft.
Healing Hands — touch a creature to heal it (Proficiency Bonus in d4s), once per Long Rest
Light Bearer — knows the Light cantrip
Celestial Revelation (level 3) — transform to gain wings, radiant aura, or a necrotic shroud

name: Dragonborn
traits: Draconic Ancestry — choose a dragon type that sets damage type and Breath Weapon shape
Breath Weapon — replaces an action, area damage equal to your ancestry's type, uses scale with level
Damage Resistance to your ancestry's damage type
Darkvision 60 ft.
Draconic Flight (level 5) — sprout wings and fly for 10 minutes, once per Long Rest

name: Dwarf
traits: Darkvision 120 ft.
Dwarven Resilience — resistance to Poison damage, advantage on saves vs. the Poisoned condition
Dwarven Toughness — extra hit point per character level
Stonecunning — Expertise on Intelligence (History) checks about stonework, tremorsense 60 ft. through stone when casting Stonecunning

name: Elf
traits: Darkvision 60 ft.
Fey Ancestry — advantage on saves vs. the Charmed condition, immune to magical sleep
Keen Senses — proficiency in Insight, Perception, or Survival
Trance — needs no sleep, 4-hour meditation instead
Elven Lineage — choose Drow, High Elf, or Wood Elf for a bonus cantrip that scales with level

name: Gnome
traits: Darkvision 60 ft.
Gnomish Cunning — advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic
Gnomish Lineage — choose Forest Gnome (Minor Illusion + Speak with Animals) or Rock Gnome (Mage Hand with Tinker variant)

name: Goliath
traits: Giant Ancestry — choose a benefit (Cloud's Jaunt, Fire's Burn, Frost's Chill, Hill's Tumble, Stone's Endurance, or Storm's Thunder), usable Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest
Large Form (level 5) — become Large for 10 minutes, once per Long Rest
Powerful Build — advantage on checks to end the Grappled condition, counts as one size larger for carrying capacity

name: Halfling
traits: Brave — advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition
Halfling Nimbleness — can move through the space of any creature Medium or larger
Luck — reroll a 1 on a d20 Test
Naturally Stealthy — can hide behind a creature at least one size larger

name: Human
traits: Resourceful — gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest
Skillful — proficiency in one skill of your choice
Versatile — gain an Origin feat of your choice

name: Orc
traits: Adrenaline Rush — Dash as a Bonus Action and gain temporary hit points, Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest
Darkvision 120 ft.
Relentless Endurance — drop to 1 HP instead of 0 once per Long Rest

name: Tiefling
traits: Darkvision 60 ft.
Fiendish Legacy — choose Abyssal, Chthonic, or Infernal legacy for a scaling bonus spell
Otherworldly Presence — knows the Thaumaturgy cantrip
Resistance to the damage type matching your fiendish legacy
